nom: Algenist Genius Liquid Skin Resurfacing Toner

avis.texte: Years ago I was given samples of several Algenist products. After using the samples I purchased the products. This stuff works best for me. I try all the newest high end products and feel that Algenist works the best.

5 stars for sure!! I love the stuff! I know it's not meant to be a "cleaner" however, I literally scrubbed my face with a pretty high-end product and then washed my face with another, and then when it came time to use this toner with a cotton pad, the cotton pad was literally dirty. So I'm questioning my scrub and my facial cleanser now,, I think I'll switch to all Algenist.
